styles.name: Реализм
styles.stylePrompt: Photorealistic editorial lifestyle photography. Natural skin, hair, fabric and material textures, physically plausible soft daylight, realistic adult proportions and natural expressions. Render the whole scene consistently as a real photograph. No illustration, cartoon, watercolor, painting, 3D render, text, UI, frames or watermarks.

styles.name: Рисунок
styles.stylePrompt: Modern editorial drawing with a subtle graphic-novel influence. Clear expressive ink outlines, simplified anatomically realistic adult shapes, restrained colored-pencil grain, designed color fills and gentle shadow planes. Readable faces and balanced warm colors. No photorealism, watercolor washes, caricature, anime, 3D render, text, UI, frames or watermarks.

styles.name: Акварель
styles.stylePrompt: Traditional transparent watercolor on textured cold-pressed paper. Layered translucent pigment washes, delicate granulation, soft wet-on-wet edges and restrained crisp brush accents on readable faces. Natural adult proportions, warm daylight and balanced colors. Paint edge-to-edge without a paper border. No photorealism, heavy ink outlines, cel shading, impasto, caricature, 3D render, text, UI, frames or watermarks.
